_about: The poses, launcher icons and moment pictures of AnkiQuest's companions, read by the server, the clients and tools/art-check; each master is <companion>/<name>.png, listed in manifest.json. Every name appears once, in one group. core lists the poses every live companion needs, in order: a new companion goes live only with all of them drawn. extensions are tiers and variants of a core pose. pictures are the moment, share-card and notification pictures the apps show. icons are the launcher icon moods; icon is the default one. In extensions, pictures and icons each name maps to its fallback, which a companion with no master for it shows: a core pose or another name whose chain reaches one. core_fallbacks maps a core pose to the core pose shown instead, used only while a companion has no master for that core pose (manifest.json lists those under missing). Fallbacks are a stopgap until every live companion has everything drawn (AnkiQuest/AnkiQuest-Server#57, #116): a core_fallbacks entry goes once every live companion has that pose drawn.
